title: An open offer of help

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?

currentLearnerUtterance: How could we be of most help today

should: Express Dana’s established preference to leave soon and have a say, or her present concern.
Answer the actual offer of help in one to three short sentences.
mustNot: Do not use generic clarification for this clear question.
Do not invent a treatment request, medication preference, or discharge promise.
